supplementalBreakdowns.basis: SHEEO's current Grapevine download reports revised FY2024 state support collected primarily from state finance and budget officers. State support excludes capital outlays/debt service, federal funds, tuition/fees, and auxiliaries. Use rows reproduce $1,178,499,775 of state support.
